gloss: faintly, slightly, just a hint of

definitions.explanation: To a very slight degree; having just a trace of something. Often describes subtle colors, scents, or sensations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほんのり⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
ほんのり⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほんのり⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The sky began to grow faintly bright.

examples.japanese: ほんのり⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。

notes:
USAGE: ほんのり describes subtle, gentle degrees of sensory experiences - colors, scents, temperatures, or tastes. It has a soft, delicate nuance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ほんのり⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧ (faintly red)
- ほんのり⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧ (slightly sweet)
- ほんのり⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧ (slightly warm)
- ほんのり⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧ (faintly bright)
- ほんのり⟦{香|かお}る→香る：14841_kaoru⟧ (to have a faint fragrance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うっすら→うっすら：10236_ussura⟧: Faintly, dimly (often visual)
- ⟦かすかに→微か：10301_kasuka⟧: Faintly, barely (more general)
- ほんのり: Slightly, just a hint (pleasant, soft quality)

NUANCE: ほんのり often conveys a pleasant, aesthetically pleasing quality of subtlety.
